territorial_scope.description: Grant programs administered by Massachusetts executive offices and designated quasi-governmental bodies for activities in the Commonwealth.

evidence.quote: to provide grants to private businesses that are constructing or expanding commercial, industrial or manufacturing facilities in the commonwealth

summary.short: Section 3A of this Massachusetts bill appropriates grant and capital funds through the Executive Office of Economic Development, including $75,000,000 for artificial intelligence development grants, with funds available until June 30, 2036.
summary.long: Section 3A of this bill makes listed sums available for the Executive Office of Economic Development, until June 30, 2036, for economic development, community development, local government support, innovation and job creation, subject to laws regulating public fund disbursement and in addition to prior authorizations. Listed items include: $20,000,000 for matching grants, via the Massachusetts Development Finance Agency's growth capital division, to certified community development financial institutions and community development corporations for small-business loans, prioritizing disadvantaged businesses; $25,000,000 for capital grants to private businesses constructing or expanding facilities, including decarbonization and climate-resilience features; $75,000,000 for grants supporting artificial intelligence development and application in strategic sectors, to public, non-profit and private entities; $100,000,000 for defense-sector investment including artificial intelligence and cybersecurity; $25,000,000 for robotics research and development grants to non-profit, university and private entities; and smaller items for food science, arts and culture, downtown revitalization, early-stage business sites and local grants. Several items require geographic equity.

notes: Excerpt (partial) of Section 3A: appropriation line items 7002-8046 to 7002-8087 only, with no enactment, effective-date, definitional or enforcement provisions. No amendment, repeal, legal-basis or enacted-by relation is stated. The four relations are cross-references to General Laws chapters, with target IDs left null. Item 7002-8046 earmarks not less than $10,000,000 within its $20,000,000 line; the earmark is not additive. AI-related programmes appear in items 7002-8080 ($75,000,000) and 7002-8082 ($100,000,000, defence sector including AI). Amounts are as written and not summed.

events.date_text: The sums set forth in this section shall be made available until June 30, 2036.

thresholds.note: Section 3A is an appropriations section listing dollar sums for named programs (e.g., 7002-8046 $20,000,000; 7002-8079 $25,000,000; 7002-8080 $75,000,000). These amounts allocate funding and set no cutoff that changes legal treatment of any person, entity or activity. The one floor, 'not less than $10,000,000 shall be expended to The Massachusetts Business Development Corporation' under 7002-8046, is a spending earmark rather than a scope, eligibility or obligation threshold. No eligibility or size cutoffs are stated in the text.
